request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee Support for 12 months across community-facing technical coordination, protocol governance and evolution, and technical review.

claims.claim: Intersect's Technical Steering Committee requests $298,250, equal to 1,193,000 ADA, to support activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
WP2 will fund the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group to support protocol settings, the CIP pipeline, and safe coordination of protocol upgrades.

WP3 will establish a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, recorded and published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible review of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Intersect will administer funds through a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, describes three work packages, states dependency on IntersectMBO budget approval, provides budget allocations, prior funding disclosure, NCL compliance, assurance plans, and smart-contract fund-management arrangements.
